# Create aggregated result table: count of single-faced, Premodern-legal cards
# whose English text contains the exact phrase "This is a triggered mana ability."

sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM cards_legal_text
  WHERE lower(coalesce(sts_premodern, '')) = 'legal'
    AND lower(coalesce(language, '')) = 'english'
    AND text ILIKE '%This is a triggered mana ability.%'
    AND coalesce(otherfaceids, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(side, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(facename, '') = ''
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS count_cards
FROM filtered;
"""
